title: Astro Portal horizon mask
description: A 36-point horizon mask (azimuths 0, 10, ..., 350, in that order; written by packages/portal/src/planner/horizon-mask.js normaliseHorizonMask) owned by a place. A mask stored on a coarser grid (the former 12 points at 30 degrees, or any grid from 10 to 30 degrees that divides 360) is still read: the readers resample it by linear interpolation onto the 10-degree grid, which leaves the curve, hence every horizon altitude, unchanged; nothing rewrites it, the next write stores 36 points. Owned by a place (packages/portal/src/planner/state.js:71-79 emptyHorizon, :175-186 normalizePlace, :187-328 migratePlannerState) and the view's circular/linear projection and rotation (state.js defaultPlanView.horizon). A profile orphaned by migration (no matching place) is kept, not discarded, as an unassigned profile.

surveyedAt.description: The instant this 10° sector was last surveyed (augmented reality, or moved by hand); absent: « à relever ». Kept only on the 10° grid.
